description: git — enforce git safety on Bash git commands (PreToolUse): block push/pull/fetch, bulk adds, non-FF merges, protected-branch ops, soft-reset to moving refs, reset --hard, --no-verify, and discards of uncommitted work (rebase/amend/checkout-file pass by default). Kill-switch: GIT_GUARD_OFF=1 (relax tokens: GIT_GUARD_ALLOW, GIT_GUARD_ALLOW_FETCH).
